answer: The voyage schedule is applied in thread and atlas shows each instalment. A payout is split thus 41% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Someone thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1149 identities would post 3287 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
